notes: createConsola({ reporters: [custom] }) with a reporter that appends JSON.stringify of the entry; logger.info(message, fields). Throttle is off so repeated records are not collapsed.
details: consola has no JSON reporter, so the adapter's own reporter writes the line, as the documentation shows for custom reporters. Its default throttle (1 s, 5 repeats) collapses identical records, and the benchmark logs the same records again and again, so throttle is set to 0; with defaults the correctness check passes but the timed loop would drop records.
